en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a seated woman in a long dark dress with a high lace collar and cuffs, likely from the early 20th century. She sits on a rustic-looking bench in front of a painted backdrop showing trees and a lake or river landscape. She holds a rectangular object, possibly a document or book, in her lap. There is faint studio text along the left edge of the image.
